title: paper_v2 session_day archive vs source schema divergence — handler must derive data_quality + actual_bar_count
description: Archive paper_v2_session_day has trade_session_id, actual_bar_count, data_quality that source lacks. Live source schema: session_id, status, phase, data_source, last_processed_bar_time. Round-2 fix kept data_quality 4-val CHECK as archive-derived field. T14b handler must compute data_quality from (expected_bar_count vs actual_bar_count comparison) and actual_bar_count from minute-bar count between session phase boundaries. trade_session_id is renamed source.session_id — pure mapping. Deferred from round-2.
required_verification: design pass for data_quality categorization thresholds (see BUG-011)
T14b unit tests for actual_bar_count counting + data_quality mapping
closure_requirements: actual_bar_count derivation source (minute_bar table query) confirmed

events.note: Round-2 P1.4 audit kept data_quality CHECK as archive-derived; flagged as deferred design pass

T14b PaperV2ArchiveHandler synthesize_data_quality implemented + unit tested. Mapping: actual=NULL -> 'missing'; actual >= expected -> 'ok'; actual >= expected*0.5 -> 'partial'; otherwise -> 'low_coverage'. Caveat (per dw-foundation drawer e943f994b1225e6016f9ed8a): the 'derived actual' is computed via COUNT(*) on intraday_snapshots, which under-reports on sparse-capture days and overestimates data_quality categories. KEEPING STATUS=OPEN until source schema gains a proper actual_bar_count column or the derivation is tightened with a tick-level data feed. dw-foundation commit bd098f8
